Name: Klavier Gavin in Stardew
Author: hychlorions
Description:
This mod replaces Elliott with Klavier Gavin from Ace Attorney. Includes winter speaking portraits, a spouse portrait, and gift taste changes. Adds some new gifting dialogue, as well as small edits to existing dialogue, albeit not as much german as I'd like, as I'm not a native speaker TT. Overall, not a lot of big changes aside from image assets, as they're basically the same character :)

This mod requires content patcher. Simply drag and drop the contents of the zip file into your mods folder and enjoy ^^

Downloads.Description: Adds new dialogue for catching the player dumpsterdiving
